symptom: `create java action` with a `/** … */` doc comment writes a .java file with no class javadoc, and `create or modify java action` removes the one mxbuild wrote above `public class`; the next build puts it back, so every rewrite is a pair of unrelated VCS diffs. describe shows the documentation and the unit has it — the model is intact
cause: `GenerateSource` (sdk/javaactions/source.go) had no documentation argument: it wrote the imports, a blank line, then `public class`. Neither `WriteJavaSourceFile` (backend.JavaBackend, mdl/backend/modelsdk/java_write.go) nor its caller in mdl/executor/cmd_javaactions.go passed the documentation, though the executor had it at hand
file: `sdk/javaactions/source.go` (`classJavadoc`, `escapeJavadocBackslashes`), `mdl/backend/java.go` + `modelsdk/java_write.go` (new `documentation` argument; mock, mcp unsupported_gen.go and modelsdk unimplemented_gen.go regenerated), `mdl/executor/cmd_javaactions.go` (passes ja.Documentation — the carried one); goldens `sdk/javaactions/testdata/mxbuild/JA_Doc*.java.golden`, tests `classdoc_golden_test.go`, `mdl/executor/cmd_javaactions_class_javadoc_test.go`
insight: Measure the format against mxbuild with documentation set straight in the model, not through a `/** */` doc comment, which trims every line and cannot hold `*/` — the upstream proposal's format was right on line structure but missed two things only an exact string shows: `\r` alone also ends a line, and a backslash is DOUBLED unless `u`/`U` + four hex digits follow it (`\u0041` and `\U0041` stay, `\user` and `\uuu0041` double) so javac cannot read a broken unicode escape in the comment. Whitespace-only documentation is still a block. mxbuild refuses `*/` in a Java action's documentation as a model error ('Documentation contains invalid characters, */ is not allowed'), so the block cannot be closed early in a project that builds. Pass the documentation the model ENDS UP with (ja.Documentation after carriedDocumentation), not the statement's, or `create or modify` without a doc comment still strips the block. The proof that VCS churn is gone is the next build: on 15 measured actions mxbuild rewrote 14 files after the baseline's rewrite and 0 after the fix's
